topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Of course, I'd be delighted to help you set up a garden in the yard! It’s such a lovely idea, and I can already imagine how vibrant and lively it would make the space. We can pick out a spot that gets plenty of sunshine and has good drainage. I’ve got a few gardening books that might help us choose the best plants for the area. Maybe we can even plan a little corner for some aromatic herbs. It would be a pleasure to see the garden grow and flourish. Let’s pick a day that works for you, and we can start planning it out together!
